description: GitHub Actions version bumps. Renovate is enabled solely to widen
peer-dependency ranges as new majors are released: a new shiki@N
ships → Renovate opens a PR widening `peerDependencies.shiki` from
`^N-1` to `^N-1 || ^N` for review and verification. Without this,
peer ranges silently drift (today: `shiki: ^4`, but shiki@5/6 will
come; today: `marked: ^18`, and major bumps happen often).

packageRules.description: Hand everything that isn't a peer dep back to Dependabot.
Widen peer ranges to include each new major as upstream ships it.
prBodyNotes: Widens a peer range to admit a newly-published upstream major. **Verify compatibility before merging** — Renovate cannot test that SvelTeX still works with the new major, only that the range now nominally allows it.
